# pipeline-analytics API

> REST API for pipeline-analytics, a self-hosted CI pipeline analytics
> server for GitHub Actions and Forgejo Actions. Endpoints cover tracked
> repos, pipelines and their step/flaky-run breakdowns, usage, WebAuthn
> auth and API tokens, and server metadata; every endpoint except the
> WebAuthn ceremony and the forge webhook receivers requires an
> authenticated session or a bearer API token.

This page (Scalar) renders the OpenAPI 3.1 description below.
There's also a read-only MCP server at `POST /api/mcp` exposing the same
pipeline health, trend, flaky-step and usage data as six tools over the
Streamable HTTP transport, using the same bearer token as the REST API.

## Docs

- [API reference](https://alrayyes.github.io/pipeline-analytics/): rendered, browsable docs for every endpoint
- [OpenAPI spec](https://alrayyes.github.io/pipeline-analytics/openapi.yaml): the raw OpenAPI 3.1 YAML this page renders

## Source

- [pipeline-analytics on GitHub](https://github.com/alrayyes/pipeline-analytics): source, README (install/config/MCP setup) and issue tracker
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/alrayyes/pipeline-analytics/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): how the server is put together, and the ADRs behind why
